studies.title: The European rabbit
studies.caption: A European rabbit pauses at the edge of its burrow. People later carried this animal far beyond its original range in southwestern Europe.
studies.prompt: Low intimate full-body Oryctolagus cuniculus beside burrow in dry Iberian scrub, grey-brown fur, moderately long ears, rounded body and short white underside tail, crouched hind legs and small forepaws. Not a long-legged hare, no domestic floppy ears, no humans.
